source: HGTECH investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-24-2026)

HGTECH.why: Makes 800G / 1.6T optical transceivers for AI data centers (Thailand and Wuhan capacity, 800G LPO in volume at a North American customer); its stock benefits directly from optical interconnect demand.
HGTECH.evidence: HGTECH investor Q&A (09-22-2026): Thailand phase-1 monthly capacity 20 ten-thousand units (1.6T ~2, 800G ~18 ten-thousand); Wuhan to reach 800G 80-100 ten-thousand and 1.6T 20 ten-thousand per month by year-end.

players.product: 800G / 1.6T optical transceivers (incl. 800G LPO) on in-house silicon photonics chips; 3.2T / 6.4T NPO engines in customer testing

quarterly_data.quarter: HGTECH investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: overseas, its 1.6T transceivers are delivered in volume to overseas integrators and channel partners; the 800G LPO series is in volume delivery to a leading North American customer 'A' with order size still rising; 1.6T FRO/LRO, the mainstream overseas products, are in testing at leading overseas AI companies.

quarterly_data.quarter: HGTECH investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: its self-developed silicon photonics chips are in scaled use, supporting volume deliveries of 400G, 800G and 1.6T transceivers; it has completed development of highly integrated silicon photonics chips for 3.2T/6.4T CPO/NPO; it has also positioned itself in upstream chip maker Yunling Optoelectronics.

quarterly_data.quarter: HGTECH investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: at CIOE 2026 it gave live demonstrations of a 3.2T CPO optical engine, 6.4T NPO, 12.8T XPO and a 3.2T transceiver with 400G per lane (demonstrations, not shipments).
